why: I checked each verifier check's PASS/FAIL conditions against the words of its expect line. Checks 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 stay mostly within their words. Check 3 goes further than expect line 3, "exports lint(text) returning [{ line, error }]". Its PASS condition requires `Object.keys(x).sort().join()==='error,line'`, so an object with any extra key fails. It also requires `typeof x.error==='string' && x.error.length>0`, which the words don't ask for: they don't say error must be a non-empty string rather than, say, an Error object. These are tests the words do not force, and they sit in a PASS/FAIL condition instead of under Advisory. The builder brief's "(exactly those two keys)" shows the stricter reading was a choice, not something the words demand. So the criterion breaks at Check 3.
